Vector Editor · free, in your browser

A free Illustrator alternative in your browser

For logos, icons and simple illustrations without an install or a subscription: Vector Editor has the pen, shape and type tools, layers and pathfinder, with familiar shortcuts. Your drawings stay on your computer.

Open Vector Editor

How to do it

  1. Choose File > New… and a size (Letter, A4, Instagram, HD, Story or custom), or open an SVG.
  2. Draw with the Pen (P), Pencil (N), Paintbrush (B), shapes, Star and Polygon, and set type with the Type tool (T).
  3. Combine shapes with Object > Pathfinder: Unite, Minus Front, Intersect and Exclude.
  4. Use linear and radial gradients, clipping masks and compound paths, and align with Smart Guides.
  5. Export SVG, PNG, JPG, PDF or a PDF-compatible .ai.

Not there yet: opening .ai or PDF files, multiple artboards, text on a path and image trace. One artboard per document.

Your files stay on this device: Vector Editor runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Vector Editor free?

Yes. There is no plan, no account and no watermark on what you export.

Can I give my file to someone who uses Illustrator?

Yes. Export as .ai (PDF-compatible) or PDF keeps the vector paths, and SVG opens in most vector apps.

Does it save my work?

It keeps an autosave on this device and recovers it on your next visit. Save As… downloads an SVG you can open again later.

Is Vector Editor made by Adobe?

ITpris Verktyg is not affiliated with Adobe. Illustrator is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to say what this app can stand in for.
